name: Taelan’s miniature warhammer
shortDescription: Taelan’s miniature warhammer, represented in the Classic Tirion and Taelan research story.
body: Small childhood gift that connects Tirion and Taelan; the design is interpretive and not an exact Classic item model. This original interpretation is not canonical game art or evidence for an exact appearance, event or location. See the story’s visual asset ledger for the matching-build review gate.
